title: Add Cursor Cloud specific instructions to AGENTS.md
body: Adds a `## Cursor Cloud specific instructions` section to `AGENTS.md` with non-obvious notes for future Cloud Agents: - Rust toolchain requirement (edition 2024 needs 1.85+; pre-installed VM toolchain is 1.83) - System dependencies needed (`libssl-dev`, `pkg-config`, `libstdc++-13-dev`) - Build timing expectations (~80s for check, ~6min for release on 4-core) - Install flow via `scripts/install_release.sh` - Test behavior in environments without provider credentials (~22 expected failures) - Binary location after build **Verified**: `cargo check`, `cargo build --release`, `cargo test --workspace` (1450 pass / 22 fail), `scripts/install_release.sh` all work on Cloud Agent VM.
